Add spring newsletter discount codes

An order takes one discount code through applyCode: SPRING10 takes 10 %
off its items, rounded half a cent up, and WELCOME5 takes 5.00 € off
items of 30.00 € or more. A second code replaces the first; an unknown
code or a WELCOME5 on a smaller order is refused and the order is left
as it was. Totals show the discount as discountCents, and shipping is
still decided on the items before any discount.
